bandwidth.title: NVIDIA NVLink and NVLink Switch specifications
bandwidth.note: NVLink 6 publishes 3.6 TB/s bidirectional bandwidth per GPU but no public pJ/bit.

optimistic_c2c.title: Inside NVIDIA Grace CPU
optimistic_c2c.note: NVLink-C2C is reported at 1.3 pJ/bit for an advanced-package coherent die-to-die link.

nominal_and_conservative.title: Quantifying Interconnect Energy Efficiency on Perlmutter
nominal_and_conservative.note: The paper cites 8 pJ/bit for early NVLink and measures 70.9 +/- 1.0 pJ/bit for the wider A100 NVLink active path.

warnings: The 8 pJ/bit nominal value is a generation-mismatched literature proxy, not an NVLink 6 measurement.
The 1.3, 8.0, and 70.9 pJ/bit values use different integration and measurement boundaries and must not be interpreted as P10/P50/P90.
